model-export-missing-meta-schema.error_signature: export_all KeyError meta_schema on reverse-engineered db/model.json

rounds.action: 정본 의미는 바꾸지 않고 /tmp 검토 사본에 exporter 호환 메타데이터만 주입해 task artifact로 초안 산출물을 생성한다
rounds.evidence: export_all.py line 23 requires M['meta_schema']; model.json top-level keys lack meta_schema and generated_at
rounds.expected_result: 03_model.dbm이 8 tables, 80 columns, 6 relationships로 생성되고 XML 파싱에 성공한다
rounds.hypothesis: 기존 역설계 model.json이 exporter 필수 메타데이터 meta_schema와 generated_at을 포함하지 않아 검토용 산출물 생성이 시작되지 못했다
rounds.result: meta_schema와 generated_at 보완 후 export가 column.domain KeyError로 다시 중단됨; 기존 모델은 column.data_type 직접형이며 framework exporter 입력 계약과 다름

rounds.action: 운영 DB와 framework를 수정하지 않는 task artifact adapter로 03_model.dbm만 생성하고 XML·8 table·80 column·6 relationship을 검사한다
rounds.evidence: 80개 컬럼 모두 column.type을 사용하고 column.domain은 0개이며 FK는 최상위 relationships, unique는 이름+컬럼 객체로 저장됨
rounds.expected_result: review-only 03_model.dbm XML 정합성 및 개수 검사가 통과한다
rounds.hypothesis: 기존 역설계 모델은 framework prospective-design contract와 달라 공식 export 전 논리 검토에는 현재 type·relationship·unique 구조를 직접 읽는 review-only DBM adapter가 필요하다
rounds.result: sealed logical_review_dbm check: XML well-formed, tables=8, columns=80, relationships=6, 한글 aliases 포함

cause_history.evidence: 첫 검증은 임시 DB에 DDL 적용·FK 거부·CASCADE까지 PASS했고 구조 개수도 8/80/6이었다. 최초 dump 31줄 차이는 무작위 restrict 토큰과 주석뿐이었다. 이후 오류는 공식 postgres:15-alpine entrypoint가 임시 초기화 서버를 열었다가 닫고 최종 서버를 시작하는 구간에서 발생했다.

investigation.data_changes: 임시 컨테이너는 --rm이고 동일 이름 잔존 없음; named volume을 쓰거나 재사용하지 않음; TemporaryDirectory는 제거됨. 운영 DB는 schema-only pg_dump 읽기만 했고 데이터·DDL 변경 없음.

investigation.recent_changes: 첫 PASS 이후 model.json과 생성 DDL 내용 변경 없음. 재생성 DDL과 db/out DDL 바이트 동일. 이후 변경은 validate_ddl.py의 dump 잡음 정규화와 Docker readiness 로직뿐. 상세 git diff는 조사 파일에 기록.
investigation.search: 공식 이미지 /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh 확인: docker_temp_server_start 후 docker_temp_server_stop, init process complete 출력 뒤 최종 exec postgres. 기존 사건 task_state도 같은 초기화 경합 순서를 기록. 프로젝트 내 별도 동일 사건은 없음.

pgdump-nondeterministic-noise.error_signature: schema-only dumps differ only by random restrict token and public schema comments

retries.note: UUID 컨테이너+tmpfs, entrypoint 초기화 완료 문구와 최종 bomts pg_isready를 모두 확인한 뒤 실행; 8/80/6, FK/CASCADE, normalized pg_dump diff 0

rounds.action: normalize dumps by excluding comments, blank lines, and restrict/unrestrict meta commands while retaining all SQL statements
rounds.evidence: 31 diff lines; all changes are restrict/unrestrict tokens, blank lines, and public schema comment block; temporary schema counts and smoke passed
rounds.expected_result: normalized generated and production schema SQL have zero diff lines
rounds.hypothesis: pg_dump emits random restrict tokens and environment-dependent comments that are not schema statements
rounds.result: dump normalization was applied, but retry stopped before comparison because temporary server accepted connections while database bomts did not exist

rounds.action: start the temporary server with default database, wait for postgres, then create database bomts explicitly before applying DDL
rounds.evidence: psql FATAL database bomts does not exist after pg_isready returned success
rounds.expected_result: temporary database exists, DDL and smoke tests pass, normalized dump diff is zero
rounds.hypothesis: pg_isready only confirms server acceptance and does not guarantee POSTGRES_DB creation completed
rounds.result: explicit createdb still raced with asynchronous initdb/entrypoint initialization immediately after pg_isready

rounds.action: poll psql SELECT 1 on postgres, check whether bomts accepts SQL, and run createdb only when it does not
rounds.evidence: createdb returned nonzero immediately after pg_isready; command output was captured and the temporary container was removed
rounds.expected_result: stable temporary database initialization followed by zero normalized schema diff
rounds.hypothesis: SQL readiness must be established with psql, and database creation must tolerate the entrypoint having already created bomts
rounds.result: psql readiness reached the entrypoint temporary server; it shut down before createdb, so validation could not continue

xlsx-core-properties-none.error_signature: openpyxl core properties serialization fails when created/modified is None

rounds.action: set deterministic timezone-aware datetime values instead of None, then regenerate all outputs
rounds.evidence: traceback at workbook.properties.to_tree after created and modified were assigned None
rounds.expected_result: DDL, DBM, and XLSX generation succeeds and export consistency check passes
rounds.hypothesis: openpyxl requires datetime values for W3CDTF core properties
rounds.result: deterministic datetime properties allow all three exports; consistency check confirmed 8 tables, 80 columns, 6 relationships
